```{r load-packages, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(shiny)
library(rmapshaper)
library(DT)
library(sf)
library(htmltools)
library(leafsync)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(ggthemes)
library(ggridges)
library(ggmap)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(broom)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(forcats)
library(colorspace)
library(visdat)
library(naniar)
library(ggrepel)
library(styler)
library(lintr)
library(tidycensus)
library(gt)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
library(terra)

river_coords <- read_csv("~/FishyG/data/survey_sites_vancouver_isl.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

weather_raster <- rast("~/FishyG/data/Global_weather/PNWNamet_tasmax.nc.nc")
```

```{r}
river_coords <- river_coords %>%
  mutate(model = case_when(
    stream_name_pse %in% c("NANAIMO RIVER", "COWICHAN RIVER", "LITTLE QUALICUM RIVER", "CHEMAINUS RIVER") ~ "Model", TRUE ~"No model"
  ))
```

```{r}
pal <- colorFactor(c("#1b9e77", "#7570b3", "darkgrey"), domain = river_coords$model)

leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data = river_coords, ~longitude, ~latitude,
                   fillColor = ~pal(model),
                   fillOpacity = 0.9,
                   stroke = FALSE,
                   radius = 6)
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(
  leafletOutput("map", height = 600),
  absolutePanel(
    bottom = 120, left = 30, width = 250,
    draggable = TRUE,
    style = "background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); padding: 12px;
             border-radius: 5px; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);",
    titlePanel("Site Map"),
    checkboxGroupInput("model", "Model:",
                         choices = sort(unique(river_coords$model)),
                         selected = unique(river_coords$model)),
    sliderInput(inputId = river_coords$year,
                  min = min(river_coords$year),
                  max = max(river_coords$year),
                  value = max(river_coords$year),
                  label = "Year",
                  step = 1,
                  sep = "")
    )
  )


server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  filtered <- reactive({
    river_coords[river_coords$model %in% input$model, ]
  })
  
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet() %>% 
      addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap) %>%
      fitBounds(min(river_coords$longitude), min(river_coords$latitude), max(river_coords$longitude), max(river_coords$latitude))
  })
  
  observe({
      leafletProxy("map", data = filtered()) %>%
      clearGroup("stream_name_pse") %>%
     addCircleMarkers(~longitude, ~latitude,
                   group = "stream_name_pse",
                   fillColor = ~pal(model),
                   fillOpacity = 0.9,
                   stroke = FALSE,
                   radius = 6,
                   popup = ~paste0("<b>", stream_name_pse, "</b><br>Model: ", model))
  })
  
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
